recentItems.description:
The Chief Minister has called on all political parties to take a clear stand on delimitation and women's reservation, describing the proposed reforms as a historic opportunity. The CM cautioned that delimitation based solely on the current population could disadvantage southern states, while stating that the Centre's proposed approach offers a win-win situation for all. Emphasizing that women constitute nearly half of society, the CM urged opposition parties not to turn women's reservation into a political issue. The CM also highlighted the decades-long wait for women's representation in legislatures and appealed to all parties to support the implementation of women's reservation without missing this crucial opportunity.

recentItems.description:
The Supreme Court has expressed serious displeasure over the failure to light the Karthigai Deepam at the stone pillar on Tirupparankundram Hill in Madurai district, Tamil Nadu. The court made it clear that its orders cannot be undermined and directed that the lamp must be lit at the designated spot tomorrow. Taking a serious view of the alleged interference by political authorities, the Supreme Court issued contempt notices to the Tamil Nadu Chief Secretary, DGP, Madurai Collector and other officials. The court also warned against any attempt to violate constitutional principles or disregard judicial orders.

recentItems.title: ఇప్పుడూ రాజకీయాలు చేసే పార్టీలను మహిళలు క్షమించరు | CM Chandrababu Naidu's Sharp Warning in Delhi
recentItems.description:
Addressing a joint press meet in New Delhi alongside Union Ministers H.D. Kumaraswamy and Rammohan Naidu, Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu warned that women will never forgive political parties that continue to play politics over the Women's Reservation Bill. Emphasizing that now is the right time to fulfill the 30-year wait for women's quota ahead of Parliament's special sitting, he also hailed the proposal to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50 percent as a historic step. Naidu assured that parliamentary seats will increase proportionally across all states to match changing times, even as several states experience declining population growth.  
#ChandrababuNaidu #WomensReservation #LokSabha #Kumaraswamy #Etvdigital

recentItems.title: మహిళా రిజర్వేషన్ల సాధనకు ఇదే సరైన సమయం | CM Chandrababu Naidu's Big Statement in Delhi
recentItems.description:
Arriving in New Delhi, Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu addressed the media alongside Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy, stating that now is the right time to achieve the long-awaited Women's Reservation. Emphasizing that the nation has waited 30 years for women's quota and is working closely with the Centre to realize it, he also hailed the proposal to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50 percent as a historic step. Naidu assured that parliamentary seats will increase across all states to match changing times, even as several states experience declining population growth.
